_description: Recommended models for one-click setup. The embedding default is ONNX (works without extra deps). GGUF alternatives via llama.cpp handle tokenization internally but need llama-cpp-python.

recommended.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
recommended.description: Lightweight 384-dim ONNX sentence transformer (~90 MB). Good default for most codebases.

alternatives.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
alternatives.description: Lightweight 384-dim sentence transformer (23 MB GGUF). Handles tokenization internally, no tokenizers pkg needed.

alternatives.name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5
alternatives.description: Nomic embed text GGUF — 768-dim (274 MB). High quality, longer context.

recommended.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2
recommended.description: Cross-encoder reranker (90 MB). Improves retrieval ordering.
